scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a thorough job analyzing the binlog and correctly identified the root cause: HotReload test files compiled unconditionally against net472, which lacks the required .NET Core-only APIs. The analysis correctly distinguishes primary FS0039 errors from cascading FS0072 errors and identifies a separate code bug. The path was somewhat inefficient (56 tool calls, many producing oversized output that couldn't be read), but the agent recovered and reached the correct conclusion. The only weakness is not explicitly noting the net10.0-specific nature of the FS0001 type mismatch errors.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
